As Designer Plumbing Installations you will be focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points. 
( 17 augustus 2022 , Erik Schüssel ) 
For a client in the Delft region, active in the international high-tech horticultural sector, we are looking for a Designer Plumbing Installations.

You will therefore be involved in making calculations, developing new systems, drawing up flow charts and visiting customers. You will be in frequent contact with colleagues and customers to ensure that the water systems or irrigation systems meet the customers' wishes. 
Who are we looking for in this position of Designer Plumbing Installations? 
- You have practical and technical insight 
- Completed technical education such as mechanical or installation engineering 
- Experience in water technology, installation technology or irrigation systems is a plus 
- You can speak English and Dutch is a nice to have 
You will be working in a team with 3 other colleagues with whom you will be working closely on challenging projects; every greenhouse needs a different system! 
There are many career opportunities and an attractive remuneration package (basic 35,000 - 50,000 euros/year, 32 days of holiday, travel allowance, pension scheme and a profit share scheme). 
Furthermore, as Designer Plumbing Installations you will be, on a daily basis, focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points.
